title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Look at the pattern of the points in the scatterplot. Consider how the function f(x) might transform the x-values to fit the y-values. What kind of transformation does $$f(x)=-x$$ represent?

title: Analyzing $$f(x)=-x$$
text: If $$f(x)=-x$$, how does this affect the x-values? Does this transformation align with the pattern you see in the scatterplot?
